impact: The geometry tests do not verify the ticket's cross-table shared-width contract for ladders. In `test_each_geometry_detector_has_an_independent_negative_witness`, the `shared-ladder` mutation changes only GF in `ladder-secondary`, so it merely breaks GF/GA equality within that table. Reading `check_measurements` confirms it compares primary GF with primary GA and secondary GF with secondary GA, but never compares either width across the two ladders. Consequently, changing both secondary GF and GA together survives the test and the acceptance gate. This is already visible in the checked-in automatic evidence: for example, automatic-neutral passes `shared-ladder-widths` with primary GF/GA widths of 68.5244 and secondary widths of 69.9332. I checked the normative documentation and fixture provenance to refute an intentional exception: `docs/table-widths.md` requires similar widths across tables, and the fixture labels these as automatic ladders with shared widths.
title: [spec-conformance] The geometry tests do not verify the ticket's cross-table shared-width contract
